preconditions.description: The input contains exactly M+1 lines: the first line with N, M, P and M subsequent lines with edges.
N, M, and P are within the specified constraints.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints A and B are valid node indices between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for u, v in edges if is_bridge(u, v, adj) and abs(size_of_component(u, adj, removed_edge=(u, v)) - (N - size_of_component(u, adj, removed_edge=(u, v)))) < P)
postconditions.description: The output is the count of edges that are bridges (removing them increases connected components by exactly 1) and where the absolute difference in node counts between the two resulting components is strictly less than P.
